findings.title: rubric.json test case sha256_hex is placeholder instruction not actual hash
findings.detail: rubric.json line 41 has `"sha256_hex": "verify-with-echo-n-concat-sha256sum"` — a human instruction text rather than the actual computed SHA256. Any tool consuming rubric.json to validate fingerprints would silently skip the test or incorrectly compare against a non-hex string. The test case is meant to document and verify the fingerprint algorithm, not instruct the user to manually compute it.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace placeholder with actual SHA256. Input: 'logic|src/queue/store.ts|jsonparse without error handling on database content' → sha256 = '0fbc4d44bf190b06b63015d48d6edee394613c022fa71162551afc6e63542bf7'
